title: SearchParsed
description: First, non-terminal reply to search: how the engine read the text. Name matching uses residualText.

mode.description: How the text is searched; always normal until later epics add modes.

dateRange.description: The date phrase's range; null until date phrases arrive (Epic 6).

residualText.description: The text left to match once any date phrase is removed: the trimmed text, as typed.
